document_text:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) Guidelines:

Section 4.1. Eligibility Criteria:
The beneficiary must be a rural household without a pucca house or living in a kutcha house with up to two rooms. The household must be included in the SECC 2011 database or the finalized Awaas+ list.

Section 5.3. Subsidy Amount:
The assistance provided is ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas, and IAP districts.

Section 8.2. Grievance Redressal:
Beneficiaries facing delays in fund disbursement can register a grievance at the Block Development Office (BDO) or via the dedicated state portal.
rti_query: I, Ramesh Kumar from Haritpur District (a hilly state), applied for the housing subsidy 6 months ago. I live in a 1-room kutcha house. Am I eligible, and how much money should I get? Also, the money hasn't come yet, who should I complain to?

ai_generated.english_response:
Dear Applicant,

Based on the PM Awas Yojana (PMAY-G) Guidelines:
1. Eligibility: Since you live in a 1-room kutcha house, you meet the primary criteria (Section 4.1).
2. Subsidy Amount: As Haritpur is in a hilly state, the eligible assistance amount is ₹1.30 lakh (Section 5.3).
3. Grievance: For delays in fund disbursement, you may register a formal grievance at your local Block Development Office (BDO) (Section 8.2).
ai_generated.hindi_response:
प्रिय आवेदक,

पीएम आवास योजना (PMAY-G) दिशानिर्देशों के आधार पर:
1. पात्रता: चूँकि आप 1-कमरे के कच्चे घर में रहते हैं, आप प्राथमिक मानदंड (धारा 4.1) को पूरा करते हैं।
2. सब्सिडी राशि: चूँकि हरितपुर एक पहाड़ी राज्य में है, पात्र सहायता राशि ₹1.30 लाख है (धारा 5.3)।
3. शिकायत: निधि वितरण में देरी के लिए, आप अपने स्थानीय खंड विकास कार्यालय (बीडीओ) में औपचारिक शिकायत दर्ज कर सकते हैं (धारा 8.2)।

citations.fact: Subsidy Amount (₹1.30 lakh for hilly states)
